coverage: Original literal80ms boundary, strict overrun and backwards-clock evidence.
First fault/evidence preserved when subsequent invalid tick occurs.
Ring bounded, same Gate output with/without diagnostic calls, no normal save and only one fault save.

Actual main while AST executed with mocked ROS/publisher validates normal/fault rows and sleep; sidecar I/O failure swallowed. Mock stop is called by the test, so production finally stop chain is source-reviewed only, not executed by this test.

implementation: Original gate decision monotonic sample remains after lock acquisition; tick predicate unchanged. Evidence now/previous/delta/threshold/classification is attached only through existing first-fault latch.
Ring capacity256 cycles, primitive timestamps/durations only. No per-tick JSON/disk.
Separate wall elapsed stages: lock wait, decision, guarded command publish, journal.add, snapshot, noncontrol state publish and requested/actual sleep.
Current fault iteration appended before loop break. Partial exceptional iteration is marked after stop cleanup.

Fault sidecar control_timing_fault.json written only after original native stop, finalfeedback, journalclose and result.json; existing output files not overwritten. Ordinary diagnostic exceptions are swallowed.
risks: Measurement adds small CPU/GIL/clock overhead and may perturb observed timing; it is not timing equivalence proof.
Wall elapsed stages do not uniquely attribute OS scheduling, GIL, CPU contention or ROS internal locks. No CPU thread-time instrumentation added.
Fatal signals/OOM or process kill may prevent sidecar write; original stop/result authority retained.
Zero-only real runtime has not been executed by this agent; no ROS/hardware motion validation claimed.
Existing adapter finally latches adapter_shutdown when no earlier fault, so that normal-close reason may also produce a diagnostic sidecar.
scope: Only one runtime module and one dedicated test changed; source backup and validation are task-owned analysis files. No thresholds, native sender, candidates/scoring or source admission changes.
